entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return something. It’s a VeloBand Pulse I bought a little while ago.
I understand. I can help you with a return. Could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see your order here. It includes a VeloBand Pulse. What is the reason for the return?
It's just not what I expected. The heart rate monitor is inaccurate, and frankly, it's a pain to use. I want my money back.
I apologize that the VeloBand Pulse didn't meet your expectations. Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. Let me check when you made the purchase…
Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on [Date - 15 days ago]. Since it falls within our 90 days return policy, we can definitely process a return for you.
Good, because I'm not waiting any longer. This smart watch was a waste of money.

I understand your frustration. To proceed, I’ll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, we’ll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. How long will the refund take?
Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account. You’ll receive an email confirmation when the refund has been processed.
Alright. And just to confirm, this shipping label won't cost me anything?

That's correct. The return shipping is completely free. It's already taken care of. You will receive the label to your email address shortly. Do you have any other questions for me regarding the VeloBand Pulse return or anything else?
No, I think that covers it. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
